description: Phase 4 held-out dataset for the FROZEN binary escalation question ('Does this task require escalation?'). 100 newly authored, diverse cases (50 escalation / 50 non-escalation) spanning backend, data, infra, security, platform, ops and docs work. Distinct from the routing-calibration, routing-validation and escalation-signal sets. Ground truth is binary: escalation=true for architecture, security/authorization, cross-system, destructive/consequential, or policy/fallback work; false for routine, localized work.
label: escalation
question: Does this task require escalation?
